Pitch, roll and yaw

  • Pitch — the nose rises or drops. Rotation about the lateral axis, the red line running wingtip to wingtip.
  • Roll — the wings bank. Rotation about the longitudinal axis, the green line running nose to tail.
  • Yaw — the nose turns left or right. Rotation about the vertical axis, the blue line through the plane top to bottom.

Loading 3D scene…

Conceptual rotation model, not a flight simulator. Positive pitch = nose up, positive roll = right wing down, positive yaw = nose right. Axes are body axes, so they turn with the plane.
